cover.desc: Full color, Layer 3 palette — cel shading, hard-edged shadows, pastel field, generous negative space. Split composition on a pale cream ground. Left two-thirds: Hazama Kou in daylight, academy uniform, frayed cuffs, blank rank pin catching no light, standing with his hands in his pockets and a mild half-lidded expression, a long cloth-wrapped bundle under one arm — solid black hair as the darkest mass in the frame, hard white highlight bands across it. Behind him, flat pale sky. Right third, overlapping him at the edge and rendered a half-tone cooler: Ariake Kanade in her tower figure — hair fully down and wild, dark short coat, bare hands, one arm mid-swing, mouth open in a shout, absolutely delighted. The two halves do not acknowledge each other. Between them, running floor to ceiling as a thin pale column, the Tower. Bottom corner, small and unremarked: a gold rank pin and a blank one, lying side by side.

panels.bg: the interior of Layer 31 — a vast broken cathedral of pale stone suspended in black, staircases running at wrong angles, drifting motes of light, tone-washed with only a few hard perspective lines
panels.action: Four hours in. Nobody outside this room has ever seen it.

dialogue.text: Layer thirty-one.
Four hours, eleven minutes. Two of us.
Nobody in the building has cleared past thirty-three.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: eyes fully open, calm, scanning
chars.pose: tower figure — black high-collared coat, hood shadowing the brow, moving low along a stair rail with one hand on the sword hilt

panels.bg: broken stone, drifting light, black beyond
panels.action: He talks the whole time. It is how a swordsman with no magic stays alive.

dialogue.text: Kettle. Left flank, coming up the long stair.
Two of them. Slow ones. They're herding us.
They're always herding us. It's their whole thing.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: grinning, hair down and everywhere, entirely at home
chars.pose: tower figure — dark short coat, bare hands up and glowing, crouched on a floating slab

panels.bg: stone slab, black void, motes
panels.action: She is having the time of her life and has been for four hours.

dialogue.text: Three.
There's one under the stair. There's always one under the stair.
Thirteen months and you still don't check under the stair.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: flat, unbothered
chars.pose: half-turned, hood shadow across the eyes

panels.bg: stone, tone wash
panels.action: He does not concede the point so much as absorb it.

dialogue.text: Three.
Don't take the one under the stair.
I'm taking the one under the stair.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: delighted, mid-shout
chars.pose: dropping off the slab with both palms out

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: already moving the other way
chars.pose: vaulting the rail, sword clearing the scabbard

panels.bg: the long stair, three shapes rising out of the dark below it, light blooming off her hands
panels.action: They do not plan. They have not needed to plan for about eight months.

dialogue.text: Going loud!
You're always loud. Give me the left, take the rail.
Going LOUDER.
That isn't a plan, that's a volume.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: teeth bared, laughing
chars.pose: palm flat against stone, the whole stair coming apart in a bloom of white

panels.bg: the long stair detonating, chunks of pale stone lifting, hard radial focus lines
panels.action: This is why the front line calls her a demolition caster and why the faculty banned her.

dialogue.text: That's two! Null, that's TWO—
Are you counting? You have to actually count them—
I'm counting.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: eyes fully open, absolutely still in the middle of a collapsing staircase
chars.pose: one clean lateral cut, sword at full extension, third shape coming apart behind him

panels.bg: falling stone, dust, black void, tone-wash
panels.action: One stroke. He has been doing it this way for two years because he has nothing else.

dialogue.text: Three.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: >_<, dot eyes, arms flailing, deformed
chars.pose: chibi, standing on rubble pointing accusingly

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: chibi, dot eyes, blank, sheathing the sword

panels.bg: flat tone, chaos lines, blank background
panels.action: Register switch, mid-battlefield, three seconds after a kill.

dialogue.text: I called two. TWO. You stole the third one.
You blew up the stair it was standing on.
THAT'S CALLED SOFTENING IT UP.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: back to rendered, mild, checking his forearm wrap
chars.pose: crouched, retying the bandage on his left arm with his teeth

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: rendered again, hands on hips, still cross

panels.bg: settling dust, stone, tone wash
panels.action: Snap back. The bandage is always there and she has never asked.

dialogue.text: Layer's clear. That's thirty-one.
That's thirty-one.
Don't just repeat it. Say something. React.
Normal people react, Null. It's a documented behaviour.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: utterly deadpan, looking up at her
chars.pose: still crouched, bandage in his teeth

panels.bg: rubble, drifting motes, black
panels.action: He says something.

dialogue.text: Something.
I hate you. I genuinely hate you.
Do you know how many people have cleared thirty-one?
Two.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: flopped flat on her back, arms out, hair fanned everywhere
chars.pose: lying on cracked stone, entirely undignified

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: sitting on rubble beside her, elbows on knees
chars.pose: hood back for the first time, upper face still shadowed

panels.bg: the cleared layer, quiet, drifting light, the black void above
panels.action: Four hours. This is the part neither of them tells anybody about.

dialogue.text: I'm going to lie here until the gate opens.
Gate's ninety seconds.
Then I'm going to lie here for ninety seconds.
Don't stand over me being tall about it.
I'm sitting down.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: eyes shut, entirely relaxed, talking at the ceiling

panels.bg: stone, motes, tone wash
panels.action: She talks like this for hours and has never once been told to stop.

dialogue.text: There's a place by the west gate does fried chicken until two.
I'm going to eat about nine of them.
Mm.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: one eye open, suspicious

panels.bg: stone, close, tone wash
panels.action: She has been trying to catch him out on this for six months.

dialogue.text: You never eat.
I eat.
You eat like someone doing homework.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: nothing at all on his face

panels.bg: flat tone, close
panels.action: He has had nine of them taken. Taste went first, three years ago.

dialogue.text: I've got no palate.
Nobody has NO palate.
Mm.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: not visible — solid silhouette

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: not visible — solid silhouette
chars.pose: reaching up from the ground, taking it

panels.bg: SILHOUETTE PANEL — two solid black figures against a flat pale tone field, the gate opening behind them as a hard white vertical band. No features on either of them.
panels.action: The gate opens. Neither of them has ever seen the other's face, and both of them would say they know exactly who that is.

dialogue.text: Same time Thursday.
Same time Thursday.

panels.bg: the exit hall of the Tower at 1:40am — a long white institutional corridor of numbered booths, strip lighting, a queue rail, laminated notices, tone-washed
panels.action: Every dive ends in a corridor that looks like a dentist's.

dialogue.text: Every climb ends in the same place.
Not the top. Booth four, and a woman with a clipboard.
Divers to calibration. Handles and pins ready.
No exit without a logged reading. No exceptions tonight.

chars.name: shizu
chars.expression: flat, precise, entirely unreadable
chars.pose: seated at a booth desk in a lab coat, clipboard, tray of test items

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: mild, sleeves pushed up

panels.bg: booth four — white partition, strip light, a tray holding a scent card, a metal plate, a pin, a paper strip
panels.action: His sister runs booth four. She has run it for eleven months.

dialogue.text: Handle.
Null.
Layer.
Thirty-one. Cleared.
Sit properly. Sleeve up. You know the order.

chars.name: shizu
chars.expression: no reaction to that whatsoever
chars.pose: holding a scent card two inches from his face

panels.bg: booth partition, strip light, tone wash
panels.action: The test is four items long and takes ninety seconds.

dialogue.text: Card. Name it.
Nothing.
It's orange peel. It's been orange peel for a year.
Plate. Hot or cold.
Couldn't say.

chars.name: shizu
chars.expression: n/a — hands only
chars.pose: pressing a pin into the pad of his thumb, holding it there

panels.bg: the pin, the thumb, a bead of blood, white desk, hard light
panels.action: He does not move his hand.

dialogue.text: Anything?
Pressure. Not much.
Last month you said pressure and a sting.
Then pressure.

chars.name: shizu
chars.expression: writing, not looking up, reading a number the way you read a bus number

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: already pulling his sleeve back down

panels.bg: booth four, strip light, the queue rail beyond
panels.action: She is his sister. She went to fourteen. She has not been able to be worried since he was fifteen.

dialogue.text: Nine.
Still nine?
Still nine. Go home, Kou.
Night, nee-san.

panels.bg: Tōka Academy at 8:15am — pale stone buildings, a wide courtyard, students in dark uniforms streaming in, and behind everything, going up out of frame, the Tower
panels.action: Six hours later.

dialogue.text: And then it's morning, and none of it happened.
Sealed identities. Faculty regulation nine.
Up there I'm the best in the building. Down here I'm—

chars.name: gen
chars.expression: enormous, delighted, arm already round his neck
chars.pose: broad and heavy, hauling Kou sideways

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: mild, being dragged

panels.bg: courtyard, morning light, students, tone-washed
panels.action: Ōkubo Gen has been doing this every morning for two years and has never once been thanked for it.

dialogue.text: Hazama! You look like a corpse!
Thanks.
Were you up all night doing that thing again?
Inventory.

chars.name: gen
chars.expression: chibi, sparkling, hands clasped

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: chibi, dot eyes, flat line mouth

panels.bg: flat tone, sparkle overlay, blank background
panels.action: Register switch.

dialogue.text: Inventory! At two in the morning! For the STOREROOM!
You are the single most boring man I have ever loved.
Mm.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: rendered again, mild, eyes down

panels.bg: courtyard, tone wash, blurred students
panels.action: The lie is two years old and it is load-bearing.

dialogue.text: Gen thinks I stack crates at night.
Gen is the only person here who talks to me on purpose.

chars.name: tsubame
chars.expression: bright, pleasant, entirely without malice as she understands it
chars.pose: long high ponytail, blocking the corridor with three others

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: mild, stopping

panels.bg: the classroom corridor, morning light through tall windows, students at lockers
panels.action: Second-year 2-B. Everyone here has been measured. One of them has been measured eleven times.

dialogue.text: Hazama. Pin check's today.
Do they even measure you any more, or do they just write zero?
They still measure.

chars.name: student_a
chars.expression: laughing, not cruelly, which is worse

chars.name: tsubame
chars.expression: amused, hand over her mouth

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: waiting, mild

panels.bg: corridor, lockers, windows, tone-washed
panels.action: It isn't bullying. It's weather.

dialogue.text: Eleven times. He's been measured eleven times.
At some point that's just a hobby.
Don't be awful.
He knows we're joking. Don't you.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: a small, mild, completely convincing smile

panels.bg: corridor, flat tone, blurred faces
panels.action: Two words. He has said them roughly four hundred times.

dialogue.text: Yeah. Fair.

chars.name: student_b
chars.expression: grinning, tipping a water bottle
chars.pose: flicking water across Kou's sleeve as he passes

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: not reacting in any way

panels.bg: corridor, water beading on a dark sleeve, tone wash
panels.action: Cold water across the forearm. He walks straight through it.

dialogue.text: Oh — sorry, sorry. Didn't see you there.
It's fine.
He says that every time. Every single time.
Because it IS fine. Look at him. He's fine.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: n/a — forearm only
chars.pose: water running down the bandaged left forearm, skin not reacting

panels.bg: close on the wet bandage, flat tone, hard light
panels.action: The whole class thinks he takes it well.

dialogue.text: They think I let it go.
Temperature went at layer twelve. Two years ago.
I can't feel it. That's all that is.

chars.name: gen
chars.expression: furious on his behalf, red-faced
chars.pose: shoving between him and the lockers

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: mild, steering him away by the elbow

panels.bg: corridor, morning light, the group behind them
panels.action: Somebody in this corridor is angry. It isn't the person it happened to.

dialogue.text: Say something. Once. One time.
And then what.
AND THEN I'D FEEL BETTER, HAZAMA.
That's a good reason, actually.
Don't be reasonable at me, I'm having a moment.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: luminous, gracious, the public smile at full operating power
chars.pose: at a podium in the hall, hair up in a precise twist, gloves, gold pin catching the light

panels.bg: the academy assembly hall, four hundred seated students, banners, hard clean light — full architectural detail for the establishing reveal
panels.action: First in the year. Second-year representative. She does this eleven times a term.

dialogue.text: —and to the first-years diving this month: the tower is not a rival.
It is a syllabus. Please respect the gate times.
Thank you all very much.

chars.name: student_a
chars.expression: starry-eyed

chars.name: gen
chars.expression: clapping enormously

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: mild, clapping politely, thinking about something else

panels.bg: the hall seating, four hundred people, tone-washed
panels.action: Four hundred people admire her. It is a very specific kind of alone.

dialogue.text: She remembered my name in the corridor. My NAME.
She's incredible. She's actually incredible.
Mm.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: the smile held exactly as long as it needs to be held

panels.bg: podium, hard light, blurred audience
panels.action: Nobody in this hall has ever heard her swear.

dialogue.text: Four hundred people just heard me say syllabus.
Six hours ago I blew up a staircase.

chars.name: riko
chars.expression: small, round glasses, twin braids, tablet up, entirely unfooled

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: smile intact

panels.bg: the side of the hall, tone wash, students filing out
panels.action: Mizusawa Riko has been managing her since they were fourteen and is not stupid.

dialogue.text: You were asleep in second period.
I was resting my eyes attentively.
Kanade. Your gate log is going to be checked eventually.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: chibi, sparkling, hands together in mock prayer, halo

chars.name: riko
chars.expression: chibi, dot eyes, flat, unmoved

panels.bg: flat tone, sparkle overlay, blank background
panels.action: Register switch. The saint act does not work on Riko and never has.

dialogue.text: I am a model student and a credit to the institution.
You are banned from the tower and you dived Tuesday.
Allegedly.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: rendered, gracious, saying good morning to somebody off-panel
chars.pose: coming down the corridor with Riko

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: mild, coming the other way with the bundle

panels.bg: a wide corridor, tall windows, students between them, tone-washed
panels.action: They pass each other roughly twice a day and have done for two years.

dialogue.text: Ariake Kanade. First in the year, both years.
Same class since we were fifteen. Four desks away.
I could tell you her exam rank and nothing else.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: the public smile, warm, exactly as warm as it is for everybody

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: a small nod

panels.bg: corridor, window light, blur
panels.action: Total elapsed conversation, two years: eleven sentences.

dialogue.text: Morning, Hazama-kun.
Morning.
Sentence nine. Sentence ten.
There's a list. I didn't mean to start a list.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: smile already gone the second she is past him, thinking about something else entirely

panels.bg: corridor, tone wash
panels.action: She is thinking about the west gate and fried chicken.

dialogue.text: Boy from 2-B. Blank pin. Very quiet. Bandage, always.
Nice enough. Nobody.
West gate. Fried chicken. Nine pieces. Don't fall asleep in maths.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: mild, unbothered, already past

panels.bg: corridor, tone wash
panels.action: He is thinking about the same thing she is and neither of them will ever know that.

dialogue.text: Top of the year. Faculty's favourite. Perfect attendance.
We have nothing in common.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: not visible — solid silhouette

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: not visible — solid silhouette

panels.bg: SILHOUETTE PANEL — two solid black figures walking in opposite directions across a flat pale tone field, the corridor reduced to a single horizon line. No features. Wide empty space between them.
panels.action: Twice a day. Two years. Four hundred and something times.

dialogue.text: That's the shape of it.
Up there we've got each other's lives in our hands.
Down here we've got 'morning'.

chars.name: gen
chars.expression: mouth full, gesturing with chopsticks
chars.pose: on the roof steps with two lunch trays

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: eating steadily, mechanically

panels.bg: the academy roof at lunch, flat sky, the Tower going up out of frame behind them, tone-washed
panels.action: Lunch. Gen talks for both of them, which suits everybody.

dialogue.text: This is the worst curry they have ever produced.
It tastes like a hot coin.
It's fine.

chars.name: gen
chars.expression: chibi, aghast, hair on end

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: chibi, dot eyes, still eating

panels.bg: flat tone, chaos lines, blank background
panels.action: Register switch.

dialogue.text: IT'S FINE? You've said that about every meal for two years!
You said it about the fish incident!
The fish was fine.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: rendered, mild, looking at the tray

panels.bg: the tray, close, flat tone
panels.action: Nothing. It has been nothing for three years.

dialogue.text: Taste went at layer four. I was fourteen.
You'd think you'd remember the last thing you tasted.
I don't.

chars.name: gen
chars.expression: suddenly serious, which is rare and alarming

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: not looking at him

panels.bg: roof, flat sky, the Tower behind
panels.action: Once a month Gen gets close to it by accident.

dialogue.text: Hazama. You'd tell me if something was going on.
Nothing's going on.
Right. Yeah. Obviously.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: head tipped back, looking straight up
chars.pose: seated on the roof steps, tray on his knees

panels.bg: the Tower from directly below — vast, pale, going up past the top of the panel, no visible summit, hard perspective and heavy tone
panels.action: Thirty-one layers cleared. Nobody knows how many there are.

dialogue.text: Nine threads. Two years.
Front line says there's a floor up there that gives it back.
Nobody's proved it. Nobody's come down to say either way.

chars.name: shizu
chars.expression: flat, entirely level, sorting laundry with perfect economy
chars.pose: in a small kitchen, lab coat off, hair still tied low

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: mild, at the table

panels.bg: a small staff flat — two rooms, tone-washed, a kettle, a drying rack, one window
panels.action: They live in staff housing. He cooks; she eats it because it is required, not because it is food.

dialogue.text: You've been going up on school nights.
Mm.
That was not a question.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: n/a — hands only
chars.pose: the cloth falling away from a plain straight sword, unornamented, worn at the grip

panels.bg: the tabletop, the cloth, the blade catching a hard white band of light, flat tone
panels.action: There is exactly one object in this building that is his.

dialogue.text: No magic. Measured eleven times.
So: a stick. And information. And talking.

chars.name: shizu
chars.expression: no expression available, saying it as data
chars.pose: folding a shirt, not looking over

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: oiling the blade

panels.bg: the small kitchen, drying rack, one window, tone wash
panels.action: She went to fourteen. She has not been able to be worried about anything for two years.

dialogue.text: I should tell you to stop.
You should.
I can't make myself mind. That's the fourteen.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: level, hands still on the blade

panels.bg: close, the table, flat tone
panels.action: This is the whole engine of him and he says it like a maintenance schedule.

dialogue.text: There's a floor that gives it back.
There's a rumour that there is.
Then I'll go and check.

chars.name: shizu
chars.expression: looking directly at him for the first time in the scene, and there is nothing behind it

panels.bg: the kitchen, the window, hard flat light, tone wash
panels.action: She is not being cold. There is simply nothing left in her to be warm with.

dialogue.text: Kou. I know you're doing it for me.
I want you to understand that I can't be grateful.
I remember that I would have been.

panels.bg: the dive hall at 9:40pm — rows of couches under a low ceiling of cabling, technicians walking the aisles, a board on the far wall listing handles and layer numbers, tone-washed with hard perspective
panels.action: Thursday. Same time Thursday.

dialogue.text: Front line to hall two. Gate opens twenty-two hundred.
Thirty-eight divers in the building tonight.
Six of us go past twenty.

chars.name: pike
chars.expression: lean, hunched, one eye covered, grinning around a straw
chars.pose: sprawled on a couch with a drink

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: mild, checking his forearm wrap

panels.bg: the dive hall, couches, cabling, the handle board behind them
panels.action: Kirisu Wataru. Handle PIKE. Count twelve. Best company in the building.

dialogue.text: Null. Heard you took thirty-one.
Kettle took thirty-one. I watched.
Modest. Disgusting. Get off my hall.

chars.name: pike
chars.expression: cheerful, tapping his covered eye

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: listening properly

panels.bg: couches, cabling, tone wash
panels.action: He is the funniest man in the building and he is a warning label.

dialogue.text: Twelve. Went last month.
Can't tell if a room's cold. Can't tell if I'm bleeding.
Still find myself funny, though. That's the one I'm watching.

chars.name: nabari
chars.expression: rumpled, tired, folder under one arm, not enjoying this

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: mild

panels.bg: the aisle between couches, strip lighting, technicians
panels.action: Instructor Nabari has been not-noticing him for a year and a half.

dialogue.text: Handle and pin.
Null. Pin's blank, sir.
...Right. Yes. It is.
Gate's twenty-two hundred. Don't make me look at it.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: eyes closing as the dive takes, absolutely calm
chars.pose: flat on the couch, cabling at the temple

panels.bg: the couch from above, the ceiling of cables, light going soft and white at the edges of the panel
panels.action: Ten seconds.

dialogue.text: Down here I'm the blank pin.
Ten seconds from now I'm somebody.
That's the trade. I made it when I was fourteen.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: hood up, eyes open, scanning
chars.pose: tower figure, standing at the mouth of the layer

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: hair down, coat, bare hands, bouncing on her heels
chars.pose: tower figure, already six paces ahead

panels.bg: Layer 32 — a drowned hall, black water to the knee, colossal broken pillars going up into dark, cold light from nowhere, heavy tone
panels.action: Layer thirty-two. Two people have ever stood in this room.

dialogue.text: Oh, I hate this. I hate this immediately.
Water's knee-deep. Don't cast big.
Casting big is my entire personality.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: flat, half-turned

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: outraged

panels.bg: black water, pillars, cold light
panels.action: They argue for the entire first eleven minutes of every layer.

dialogue.text: It's your handle.
Don't call me Kettle in a serious room.
It is a KITCHEN OBJECT. I level buildings.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: >_<, tiny body, huge head, steam out of both ears

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: chibi, dot eyes, holding up two fingers

panels.bg: flat tone, chaos lines, blank background
panels.action: Register switch, knee-deep in a drowned hall on layer thirty-two.

dialogue.text: Who even PICKED it? Who did that to me?
Front line votes. It was unanimous.
WAS IT YOU.
It was unanimous.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: rendered, gone completely still, hand on the hilt
chars.pose: stopped mid-stride, water settling round his shins

panels.bg: black water going flat and mirror-still, pillars, the light dropping a value
panels.action: The register snaps back in one panel.

dialogue.text: Stop.
What.
The water went flat.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: grin gone, hands coming up, entirely professional
chars.pose: back to back with him, palms lit

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: sword clearing the scabbard

panels.bg: the drowned hall, and rising out of the black water all around them, twelve pale shapes, tone-washed and only half-drawn
panels.action: It takes them about a second and a half to stop being children.

dialogue.text: How many.

Yeah.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: calm, talking fast and clearly
chars.pose: moving, sword low, water breaking round him

panels.bg: black water, pale shapes closing, pillars
panels.action: This is what he actually is: a voice that keeps other people alive.

dialogue.text: Left pillar. Get up on it and stay up.
You cast, I hold the water. Don't come down.
And if you get surrounded down there?
Then I get surrounded. Go.
I hate when you say things in that voice.
Pillar. Now.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: teeth set, hair whipping, both palms down
chars.pose: up on a broken pillar, casting into the water below

panels.bg: the drowned hall from low, white light blooming off the water surface, shapes coming apart, radial focus lines
panels.action: Four seconds of the reason the faculty banned her.

dialogue.text: Six! Six down—

THAT'S WHAT I ALWAYS DO.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: eyes fully open, breathing hard, entirely lucid
chars.pose: waist-deep now, sword through a shape, another closing behind

panels.bg: churned black water, pale shapes, pillars, tone-washed
panels.action: He has no defence. He has never had a defence. He has footwork and a stick.

dialogue.text: Ten. Eleven.
No magic, no shield, no second chance.
Footwork, a stick, and knowing where everything is.
Kettle — the far pillar's cracking, move left—

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: turning, seeing it too late
chars.pose: on the pillar, one hand out

panels.bg: the pillar cracking through the middle, stone shearing, water rising
panels.action: She does not have time to get off it.

dialogue.text: Null—
MOVE.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: not visible — solid silhouette, arm up
chars.pose: silhouette, between her and the falling stone, sword raised across his body

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: not visible — solid silhouette, falling backward

panels.bg: SILHOUETTE PANEL — two solid figures against a flat white tone field, a wedge of falling stone as a black mass above them. No features. Nothing else in the frame.
panels.action: He gets there. That is the entire thing he is good at.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: down in the water, soaked, scrambling up
chars.pose: on hands and knees in the shallows

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: on one knee, left arm hanging, blood in the water
chars.pose: sword point down in the stone

panels.bg: the wrecked hall, settling water, the last pale shapes gone, dust and stone
panels.action: Twelve down. One clear layer. One arm opened from elbow to wrist.

dialogue.text: You absolute — you IDIOT—
Layer's clear.
I don't CARE that the layer's clear—
You put your arm in front of a falling pillar!
It was that or your head.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: furious and frightened and not able to tell them apart
chars.pose: grabbing his wrist and turning the arm over

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: mild, letting her

panels.bg: close on the two of them, water, stone, tone wash
panels.action: She has never touched him before. Neither of them notices that, which is the point.

dialogue.text: Does that hurt.
No.
Null. Does it hurt.
No.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: stopped, looking at his face and not the arm

panels.bg: close, flat tone, water light
panels.action: She has been told his count twice and has decided both times that it was a rumour.

dialogue.text: ...What's your count.
Ask me on the ground.
That's not an answer.
No.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: n/a — hands only, bare, working fast and precisely
chars.pose: wrapping his forearm, then tying it off with a distinctive doubled two-loop knot on the outside of the wrist

panels.bg: the forearm, the wrap, the knot, water beading on the cloth, flat tone, hard light. ART NOTE: this knot shape is a load-bearing plot object — establish it clearly and reuse the exact silhouette on page 18.
panels.action: Two loops, pulled through, laid flat on the outside of the wrist. She ties it that way on everybody. It is the only careful thing she does.

dialogue.text: Hold still.
Two loops. It won't come off in water.
Where'd you learn that?
Piano teacher. Long story. Shut up.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: sitting back on her heels in the water, wrecked, hair plastered down

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: looking at the knot on his own wrist

panels.bg: the cleared hall, flat black water, broken pillars, cold light, quiet
panels.action: The gate is ninety seconds away. Neither of them gets up.

dialogue.text: Thirty-two. Nobody's ever stood here.
Thirty-two.
Say something. And not 'something'.
...Good knot.
Thirteen months for 'good knot'. Unbelievable.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: quiet for once, arms round her knees
chars.pose: sitting in the shallow water beside him

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: sword across his lap, hood back

panels.bg: the drowned hall after, still water, pillars, the light gone soft, bokeh overlay
panels.action: This is the longest either of them has sat still with another person all week.

dialogue.text: A year, we've been doing this.
Thirteen months.
Of course you know the number.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: picking at the water, not looking at him, saying it lightly on purpose

panels.bg: water, soft light, bokeh circles
panels.action: She has been not-saying this for about four months.

dialogue.text: Regulation nine's stupid, by the way.
Sealed identities. I could walk past you every day.
Statistically you probably do.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: chibi, sparkling, both fists up

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: chibi, dot eyes, deeply unmoved

panels.bg: flat tone, sparkle overlay, blank background
panels.action: Register switch, mid-sincerity, exactly when it gets too close.

dialogue.text: We should break it. Right now. Names, three, two—
That's expulsion for both of us.
You're no fun. You've never been fun.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: rendered, mild, and something moving behind the eyes

panels.bg: still black water, soft light, flat tone
panels.action: He thinks about it more than he would ever admit.

dialogue.text: Whoever you are down there, you'd be disappointed.
I would not.
You would. Everyone is.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: turning to look straight at him, entirely serious, no smile anywhere

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: not looking back

panels.bg: the drowned hall, the gate beginning to open as a hard white band at the far end
panels.action: She means it. She has no idea what she is saying or to whom.

dialogue.text: Null. I've known you thirteen months.
You're the only person I've never had to be good in front of.
Whoever that is up there — I'd be fine with him.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: absolutely nothing on his face, which is itself the reaction

panels.bg: flat tone, the white gate-band bleeding in at the frame edge
panels.action: Nobody has ever said anything like that to him and he does not have a procedure for it.

dialogue.text: Don't say things like that in a dungeon.
Where else am I supposed to say them?

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: already up, already loud again, hauling him upright by the good arm

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: letting himself be hauled

panels.bg: the drowned hall, the gate open, white light
panels.action: She retreats at speed, which is the same thing he does, in the other direction.

dialogue.text: Anyway. Fried chicken.
It's one in the morning.
It's one in the morning SOMEWHERE.
That's not — that's just what time it is.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: chibi, arms full of imaginary food, drooling

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: chibi, dot eyes, trailing behind
chars.pose: chibi, arm in a sling of bandage

panels.bg: flat tone, sparkle overlay, blank background
panels.action: Register switch on the way out the door.

dialogue.text: Nine pieces. Nine. I've earned eleven.
You said nine last time.
AND I ATE NINE.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: rendered, stopped in the gate light, half-turned
chars.pose: one hand on the frame of white

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: a step behind her

panels.bg: the gate — a hard vertical band of white, the drowned hall behind
panels.action: The same two lines, every time, for thirteen months.

dialogue.text: Same time Thursday.
Same time Thursday.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: n/a — forearm only
chars.pose: the bandaged left forearm going into the white of the gate, the doubled two-loop knot clearly visible on the outside of the wrist

panels.bg: the knot, the wrap, the white gate light washing over it. ART NOTE: same knot silhouette as page 14 panel 4 and page 18 panel 4.
panels.action: The tower does not take the bandage off you.

dialogue.text: What happens up there comes out with you.
That's the first thing they teach you.
I've never once thought about what that means.

chars.name: shizu
chars.expression: flat, clipboard up
chars.pose: at the booth desk, tray of test items ready

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: sitting down, sleeve pushed up over a wrapped forearm

panels.bg: booth four, 1:52am, white partition, strip light, tone wash
panels.action: Ninety seconds, four items, one number.

dialogue.text: Handle.
Null. Thirty-two. Cleared.
Thirty-two.
That's the highest anyone in this building has logged.
I'd say congratulations if I had it. Sleeve.

chars.name: shizu
chars.expression: not reacting to the wrap at all, professionally
chars.pose: turning his arm over on the desk

panels.bg: the desk, the bandaged forearm, the knot on top, hard strip light
panels.action: She does not ask who tied it. She logs the injury and moves on.

dialogue.text: Laceration, left forearm, elbow to wrist. Field-dressed.
Mm.
Not by you. You've never been able to tie anything.
Then somebody up there is careful with you.
Noted. Not commented on.

chars.name: shizu
chars.expression: n/a — hands only
chars.pose: the pin going into his thumb, the plate under his palm, the scent card at his face

panels.bg: the tray, the four items, hard light, white desk
panels.action: Four items. He gets none of them.

dialogue.text: Card.
Nothing.
Plate.
Nothing.
Pin.
Pressure.

chars.name: shizu
chars.expression: writing, level, the way you write a bus number

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: pulling his sleeve down over the knot

panels.bg: booth four, clipboard, strip light
panels.action: One layer, one thread. It is not a surprise. It has never once been a surprise.

dialogue.text: Ten.
Ten.
One layer, one thread. It's always been one.
Go home, Kou. There's rice.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: not visible — solid silhouette, small
chars.pose: walking away down the long corridor of numbered booths

panels.bg: SILHOUETTE PANEL — one solid black figure against a flat pale field, the corridor reduced to two converging lines and a row of booth numbers. No features.
panels.action: Ten of thirty-two. Eight layers to the next record and nobody knows how many floors there are.

dialogue.text: Ten threads.
Thirty-two layers. Somebody's going to ask me why one day.
Nobody down here has ever asked me anything.

panels.bg: classroom 2-B at 8:20am — desks, morning light through tall windows, students filing in with bags, the Tower framed in the window behind, tone-washed
panels.action: Six hours later. Nothing happened.

dialogue.text: Four hours' sleep. Assembly at ten.
Smile at everybody. Sign the thing. Be first in the year.
Twelve hours until Thursday.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: chibi, dead-eyed, face-down on her desk, steam rising

chars.name: riko
chars.expression: chibi, dot eyes, poking her with a pen

panels.bg: flat tone, chaos lines, blank background
panels.action: Register switch. The public face does not switch on until 8:25.

dialogue.text: You were out again.
I was resting my eyes. In a building.
Sit up. Amasaki's watching.
Give me four seconds.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: rendered, upright, the public smile fully deployed
chars.pose: seated, immaculate, gloves on, gold pin straight

chars.name: tsubame
chars.expression: bright, leaning on the desk

panels.bg: classroom, morning light, students settling, tone wash
panels.action: Four seconds. It is a very good smile.

dialogue.text: Ariake-san, you're too good to us.
Not at all. How was your dive?
Layer three! Barely. Oh — watch out, the blank pin's coming.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: n/a — forearm only, passing at desk height
chars.pose: the left sleeve pushed back on the way past, bandaged forearm, and on the outside of the wrist a doubled two-loop knot laid flat

panels.bg: the classroom aisle at desk height, blurred desks, morning light. ART NOTE: identical knot silhouette to page 14 panel 4 and page 16 panel 5. This is the reveal; it must read at a glance.
panels.action: He does not notice her. He never notices her. He is going to his seat.

dialogue.text: Hazama. Nice bandage. Did you fall over a crate?
Yeah. Fair.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: the public smile still on her face and the eyes gone completely, absolutely, terribly still
chars.pose: frozen mid-turn, one gloved hand halfway to her bag

panels.bg: the classroom, morning light, everything behind her out of focus, hard flat tone closing in from the frame edges
panels.action: She tied that knot at half past midnight, in black water, on layer thirty-two, with her own bare hands. Final panel.

dialogue.text: ...I tied that.
Six hours ago. On the front line.
I tied that.
